top_choice_rationale: Antisense correction of SMN2 splicing offers the most sharply bounded mechanism-to-treatment achievement: a defined biological insight yielded disease-modifying benefit in spinal muscular atrophy, with a compact and complementary Krainer-Bennett attribution. Its narrower scope than the leading alternatives is outweighed by the direct causal chain and feasible citation boundary.
